items.title: Why Some 80-Year-Olds Function Like They're 30 | Dr. Ameya Patwardhan, NIMHANS-trained Neurologist
items.description:
This is a short cut from my upcoming full conversation with Dr. Ameya Patwardhan — a NIMHANS-trained cognitive neurologist (Parkinson’s & dementia). He is a Cognitive & Movement Disorders fellowship alum at Sunnybrook / University of Toronto, and now an Assistant Professor / cognitive neurologist at Western University (London, ON).

In this ~10-minute piece we sit with super-agers: people past 80 who still function like they’re in their 30s–40s — cognitively healthy aging. Ameya is clear...
